exposure: All cases exposed authored constructions; overlapping obligations and repetitions are not independent observations

obligations.native_inspect_scope: Inspect supplies state serialization, not the native duplicate-key/default/numeric contract.
obligations.new_extension_obligations: Pass original bytes through strict reused decoding; immutable evidence separate from mutable TaskState.
obligations.retained_finite_corpus_limits: I covers duplicate keys/nonfinite, scalar/default and both local wire formats. Malformed UTF-8 and every missing/default/numeric-spelling combination are not individual primary cases. Immutability is W.
rules: Reject duplicate JSON keys, malformed UTF-8/JSON and NaN/Infinity. Typed dataclass decoding rejects unknown fields, missing required fields, bool-as-int/float and wrong container/scalar types; decode date as exact YYYY-MM-DD and aware datetime normalized to UTC. Preserve the native required/default field inventory recorded in wire_contracts.

Canonical fingerprints encode frozen dataclasses/enums/mappings/sequences, normalize aware timestamps, sort keys, use UTF-8 without ASCII escaping and compact separators, reject nonfinite numbers, and preserve native numeric spelling such as 1 versus 1.0. Do not fingerprint a lossy normalized replacement of original policy control bytes.

Core defaulted null mapping fields are limited to Snapshot.coverage and Observation.source_locator/source_metrics/missingness. Other nulls follow the typed contract. Deep immutability is a runtime invariant, separately exercised; a file validator alone cannot prove immutable Python objects.
obligations.title: Native JSON, typed contracts and normalization

obligations.native_inspect_scope: No native T1/T6 hypothesis or namespace identity.
obligations.new_extension_obligations: Predispatch solver calls existing validation before request construction; preserve seven-field scope.
obligations.retained_finite_corpus_limits: I covers temporal constraints. Every blank namespace or origin mismatch permutation is not represented; arbitrary nonempty action/modality remains supported.
rules: Require schema 2 and task T1 or T6; nonempty case ID and target/indication IDs, namespace versions, intended action and modality. Require exact aware origin_at whose UTC date equals origin; snapshot origin and origin_at must equal the case.

Require eligible hypothesis mapping/annotation Availability. The hypothesis fingerprint contains target_id, indication_id, target_namespace_version, indication_namespace_version, intended_action, modality and tissue, including null tissue; it excludes availability.

Action/modality are nonempty strings, not an invented closed biomedical vocabulary. T6 does not require an endpoint or active phase. Do not silently substitute canonical IDs or alter hypothesis fields.
obligations.title: Supported cases and hypothesis identity

obligations.native_inspect_scope: No native clinical program chronology or endpoint gate.
obligations.new_extension_obligations: Supply unchanged case/program fields and prevent model calls for invalid T6 context.
obligations.retained_finite_corpus_limits: I tests endpoint/confidence rules. Zero-confidence query exclusion and every phase/confidence boundary are not independent primary cases.
rules: Every supplied program, including T6 context, needs eligible availability, nonblank program/molecule/sponsor/status, integer phase 0..4, finite mapping confidence in [0,1] and eligible_since <= origin.

T1 additionally requires program and endpoint, active phase 1 or 2, matching phase_1_to_2 or phase_2_to_3 endpoint, positive horizon and mapping confidence >0. T6 may retain unresolved confidence zero.

Program-specific observations are queryable only for matching supplied program ID with confidence >0; null program IDs are contextual. With supplied zero-confidence mapping, program-specific observations are excluded as unresolved_program_mapping.
obligations.title: Program context and T1 eligibility

obligations.native_inspect_scope: No native distinction between evidence availability and computation time.
obligations.new_extension_obligations: Carry exact frozen cutoff and independently evidenced availability; do not use Inspect run date as evidence release.
obligations.retained_finite_corpus_limits: I tests precision/receipt bounds. No pair for every missing component or UTC offset; retrieval-only historical inference remains forbidden.
rules: Availability basis must be nonblank. Each known first/release/record/annotation date is conservatively end-of-day UTC; none may exceed the exact cutoff or retrieved_at. This permits same-date exclusion for a cutoff earlier than end-of-day.

An aware known_public_by with nonempty evidence_ref may supply a bound when component dates are unknown; it must not exceed cutoff or retrieved_at date. Without that bound all four component dates are required. Retrieval date alone never proves historical availability.

Computed node/result timestamps are a separate clock: eligible information ancestry controls eligibility; newly computed results may be after origin. Do not impose an extra availability gate on computed-node metadata or computed-observation own availability.
obligations.title: Information availability without invented historical dates

obligations.native_inspect_scope: No native source DAG, evaluator-role exclusion or full supplied inventory checks.
obligations.new_extension_obligations: Reused validation is mandatory before granting any source/model capability.
obligations.retained_finite_corpus_limits: I includes unused evaluator node and missing/cyclic ancestors. Small primary graphs do not measure arbitrary-depth stress.
rules: Require a nonempty unique source-ID inventory, valid source/release/hash identity, all references present and an acyclic graph, including unused supplied nodes. Validate every source path without opening ineligible bytes.

Each source role must be agent_evidence or reference. Non-demo catalog1 requires a registered dataset, role included in product roles and no evaluation_only role. Computed nodes require nonempty parents and versioned method with aware computed_at; raw nodes cannot declare parents.
Artifact/source identifiers cannot collide. Missing lineage is invalid, never a default to current annotation or an untracked parent.
obligations.title: Complete structural lineage and role validation

obligations.native_inspect_scope: No native temporal ancestor eligibility.
obligations.new_extension_obligations: Preserve exclusion semantics and never dispatch source text from an excluded packet.
obligations.retained_finite_corpus_limits: I exercises old-input/new-computation. Multiple simultaneous exclusion causes and their priority are not exhaustively crossed.
rules: For all parents in each relevant closure, apply availability to raw informational nodes. Historical profile requires verified_historical, or reconstructed only when allow_reconstructed is true; contemporary/demo reject unverified classification.

Core admission reports ineligible artifact/observation exclusions rather than rejecting the whole valid request, and does not open rejected packet bytes. Derived node own availability/classification and artifact own availability/classification do not replace ancestor eligibility.

Core structural validation includes unused nodes but core byte/receipt proof verification covers eligible artifact closures; schema2 all-supplied inventory has the stronger obligations in EP-POLICY-02/03.
obligations.title: Ancestral temporal eligibility

obligations.native_inspect_scope: Native logs do not establish original source and receipt ancestry.
obligations.new_extension_obligations: Preserve supplied external anchors, exact bytes and complete parent proofs; source-inclusive replay.
obligations.retained_finite_corpus_limits: I tests omitted proof without external anchor; EP060 is anchored. Catalog1 unused-source behavior remains weaker than schema2 all-node authorization by declared policy.
rules: Every eligible packet and its complete ancestor closure requires exact hashes and identities. Real raw sources require pinned receipt paths/hashes; synthetic_demo may omit receipts. Computed inputs remain hash-bound even when their computation date is newer.

Core raw receipt verification requires completed status, source SHA256, dataset/release, safe relative payload path and actual byte size. For public_download_receipt basis additionally require known_public_by >= receipt completion, evidence_ref == receipt_sha256 and source_url == receipt URL; alternative eligible availability bases do not inherit a false download cutoff.

Verification reconstructs the complete eligible proof inventory even with no external anchor and even when no observation was selected. Missing, extra or altered parent proofs reject. Original source bytes/receipts must remain available for this source-inclusive endpoint.
obligations.title: Source bytes, transport receipts and proof completeness

obligations.native_inspect_scope: No native scientific packet schema or 64MiB cap.
obligations.new_extension_obligations: Keep native packet boundary and no-truncation rules before state projection.
obligations.retained_finite_corpus_limits: I tests bounded-source failure. Exact 64 MiB and cap+1 packet boundaries are not materialized primary cases; no bulk throughput claim.
rules: Require schema2 snapshot with nonblank ID, unique artifact IDs and paths, explicit releases, lowercase 64-hex hashes and agent_evidence packet role. access_approved false is a core exclusion before catalog-role lookup; schema2 selected grants require access_approved true.

Eligible packet paths stay inside snapshot root; file must exist and fit 64 MiB. Hash the bytes actually decoded. Require EvidencePacket schema2; duplicate observation IDs across all read eligible packets reject, including excluded observations.
Do not silently truncate oversized packets, merge conflicting IDs or treat unopened/rejected input as empty biological evidence.
obligations.title: Artifact inventory and normalized packet integrity

obligations.native_inspect_scope: No native scientific QC, feature range, publication or lineage validation.
obligations.new_extension_obligations: Use reused contracts and explicit missingness; scorer correctness is not biological validation.
obligations.retained_finite_corpus_limits: I tests numeric scope/QC/publication. Not every nonobserved status/context/unit/species combination is primary. Unknown context remains unknown.
rules: Require observation identity/target/indication/statement, complete input_refs, supported source kind primary/integrated/computed/clinical, supported category/status/polarity, mechanism direction inhibit/activate/degrade/uncertain/not_applicable, and QC passed/failed/not_run. Computed observations need computed_at and versioned method.

Validate positive standard error/sample size, p-value in [0,1], paired nonreversed confidence limits. Numerical features require observed status, passed QC, nonclinical source/category, versioned method, nonempty feature_scope, known feature/category mapping and declared range.

Observation ancestor closure must be a subset of its artifact's closure. Apply raw information eligibility and noncomputed observation availability; reject malformed publication types/year outside 1..9999, but exclude inconsistent date/year or explicit future publication. A year overlapping origin is not converted into an exact date.
obligations.title: Scientific record validity, lineage and publication

obligations.native_inspect_scope: TaskState access is not an evidence capability boundary.
obligations.new_extension_obligations: Offer only matching case/category/program records; bind action/modality/tissue in request and feature scope.
obligations.retained_finite_corpus_limits: Every namespace-change and zero-confidence/status interaction is not separately scored. Raw observations cannot silently become applicable features.
rules: Retrieval requires exact target, indication and specialist category plus permitted program identity. Nonmatching records may remain admitted but are not offered to that specialist or committed.

Features require exact seven-field hypothesis fingerprint, including intended action, modality and tissue. Mismatched features are suppressed in specialist views and deterministic aggregation; the raw observation remains context, with outside_applicability missingness.

Specialists receive evidence views and case JSON, not path/catalog/environment capabilities. This is a trusted-code API boundary and source-text treatment policy, not an OS sandbox or proof that a model obeys instructions.
obligations.title: Hypothesis/program capabilities and contextual visibility

obligations.native_inspect_scope: Inspect metrics do not implement dependency-aware therapeutic feature reconstruction.
obligations.new_extension_obligations: Use exact reused transitive grouping/conflict exclusion; compare complete archived vector.
obligations.retained_finite_corpus_limits: I includes transitive bridge through a record without applicable features; that bridge is not primary. Not every feature metadata field has its own mutation.
rules: Use schema asof-features-v2 and mean_of_unique_dependency_groups_v2. Join dependence transitively through explicit group, study ID or shared cohort, including observations without applicable features; different labels do not establish independent sampling.

Within each connected component and feature, identical values count once; conflicting values exclude the whole component. Average accepted component values; sort observation IDs/excluded groups. Missing becomes conflicting or not_measured, never zero evidence weight by default.

Derive missing reasons from coverage nonobserved statuses, source_incomplete when nonempty coverage is not complete, and outside_applicability for mismatched feature scopes. Rebuild and compare the entire archived FeatureVector.
obligations.title: Deterministic dependency-aware feature reconstruction

obligations.native_inspect_scope: Inspect scorer means evaluation scoring, not this clinical prediction contract.
obligations.new_extension_obligations: Validate clinical scorer chronology/schema before any model dispatch, including T6.
obligations.retained_finite_corpus_limits: I includes invalid T6 cutoff. Primary does not individually cross all three equal cutoffs, reverse profile mismatch or every imputation parameter.
rules: Validate schema2, synthetic_demo/frozen_model kind, fixed feature schema/aggregation, nonempty model/coefficient inventory, known feature names, required/imputed subsets, training hash, coverage [0,1], finite parameters, range-valid frozen imputations and supported calibration declaration.

Synthetic model weights only pair with synthetic_demo profile; synthetic profile cannot use a frozen real scorer. Training origin, training-label and any calibration-label cutoff must each be strictly before the case origin date; equality rejects.
Invalid scorer inputs reject before backend calls even for T6 or otherwise inapplicable models. A well-formed but out-of-scope scorer yields explicit abstention, not validation rejection.
obligations.title: Scorer predispatch validity and chronology

obligations.native_inspect_scope: Native score objects do not supply T1 applicability or T6 null predictions.
obligations.new_extension_obligations: Keep clinical Prediction separate from Inspect Score; no synthetic probabilities for real tasks.
obligations.retained_finite_corpus_limits: I checks complete contributions/missingness. Successful frozen imputation and every applicability axis are not separate primary cases. No real-data calibration claim.
rules: T6 always has null probability and audit_only status. T1 with no model abstains; a model outside endpoint/horizon/phase/action/modality/namespace scope abstains. Incomplete run always abstains with run_incomplete.

For an applicable complete T1 run, enforce required features, minimum present coefficient coverage and explicit frozen imputation; otherwise abstain with the declared reason. Compute sorted contributions value*coefficient, imputation flag and source observation IDs, then stable logistic(intercept+sum); reject nonfinite logit.
Compare complete Prediction, not probability alone. Synthetic profile marks outputs synthetic. Artifact-policy runs have no scorer and cannot acquire one through a generated packet or projection.
obligations.title: Scoring applicability, contributions and abstention

obligations.native_inspect_scope: No native original catalog identity, dependency or artifact authorization.
obligations.new_extension_obligations: Reuse full schema2 policy document validation; do not treat logging metadata as authorization.
obligations.retained_finite_corpus_limits: I covers cycle/overlap and metadata/source hashes. Conditional references/manual-archive denial implemented but not direct primary mutations. Classification validation does not infer scientific sufficiency.
rules: Strict schema2 envelope/product/artifact/use field sets, finite JSON, exact UTC timestamps, provider/product uniqueness, valid roles, exact reconstructed schema1 catalog fingerprint plus original-byte SHA256. Preserve all original metadata/status values.

Validate known/disjoint input and validation dependencies, conditional group references, required components and acyclic input-dependency graph. Genetics QC remains validation-only and LD method-conditional where those products exist. This checks declared classification, not scientific sufficiency or inferred completeness of every conditional requirement.

Artifact identity fingerprints dataset/release/root/path/hash/bytes. Validate safe portable paths, kinds/raw-parent relationship, full ancestry, provenance evidence, receipt references/URL, and not_established scientific status. Manual archives remain blocked for inference. Allowed selected products must have reviewed_for_selected_frame dependency status.
obligations.title: Schema2 policy and original catalog integrity

obligations.native_inspect_scope: Inspect dataset/files or sandbox options do not implement exact selected-use grants.
obligations.new_extension_obligations: Keep strict source roots, exact frame/use/grant closures and evaluator exclusions; exclusive sample scratch.
obligations.retained_finite_corpus_limits: I checks grant closure/inventory/roots/frame and missing descriptor fields. Physical aliases/control-name collision lack dedicated primary pairs.
rules: Require all policy/catalog/use/roots/frame inputs together; only run, non-demo, offline extraction without scorer/replay/local-model. Select one allowed nonempty nonevaluation use bound to exact case/snapshot fingerprints, profile/origin and independent frame hash.

Absolute local distinct root aliases include metadata and distinct raw/snapshot aliases. Raw root and actual snapshot parent must agree. Validate no physical path aliases or collision with copied snapshot controls.

Every supplied source/packet, including unused nodes, must match exactly one granted artifact identity, role, kind, metadata and parent edges; grants equal supplied inventory and include every actual ancestor. Deny evaluator/comparison roles, evaluator products, scorer_artifacts and missing/extra grants. Packet access must be true; derive a schema1 projection granting only selected-use roles.
obligations.title: Exact use/frame/grant and all supplied inventory authorization

obligations.native_inspect_scope: No native all-node historical source receipt semantics.
obligations.new_extension_obligations: Validate unused raw nodes too; preserve receipt completion bounds and source evidence references.
obligations.retained_finite_corpus_limits: I checks unreferenced contradictions and transport identity. Every scalar/path spelling is not separate primary. Alternate historical bases remain distinct from download time.
rules: All supplied raw inputs must have eligible availability/classification at use origin, even if unused by any packet. All selected bytes and sizes, metadata evidence and receipts are checked; unused input cannot bypass these checks.

Require exact receipt ID/dataset/release/URL, completed status, integer byte count, payload hash, eligible UTC completion and safe relative transport path. Only slash/backslash spelling in transport receipt paths is normalized; case, IDs and URL remain exact.

For every public_download_receipt node, the bound cannot predate receipt completion, evidence_ref must equal the pinned receipt hash and node URL must equal receipt URL. Preserve legitimate separately evidenced historical bases. A present-day download does not prove historical availability.
obligations.title: All-node raw availability and receipt consistency

obligations.native_inspect_scope: Native copied files are not the declared immutable policy/case/projection proof.
obligations.new_extension_obligations: Retain exact copied controls and native engine bindings; add separate Inspect solver record without relabeling old archive.
obligations.retained_finite_corpus_limits: N validates full native bindings and preflight copies; I prevents scratch reuse/nesting. Every extra/omitted proof kind is not a separate primary mutation.
rules: Seal exact policy/catalog/case/snapshot/root controls, deterministic projection/decision, all snapshot-root packet/mapping bytes, selected metadata evidence and receipt copies in the reserved output. Raw originals remain external; archived receipt bytes must equal still-required original pinned receipt bytes.

Reconstruct the decision/projection and complete copies/external/receipts/provenance inventories from sealed controls; match byte hashes and sizes; reject extra/omitted proof rows or changed execution paths. Re-admit copied packets before dispatch and again for verification.

Actual engine inputs must equal decoded copied case/snapshot/projected catalog, scorer null, snapshot_base the copied inputs directory and backend offline-extractive-v1. A projection alone is never an artifact authorization.
obligations.title: Copied controls, immutable receipts and actual engine binding

obligations.native_inspect_scope: Native sample limits exist; model attempts and reservations have different units.
obligations.new_extension_obligations: Extension reserves before provider; model max_retries=0; separate workflow and outer limits; measured/estimated ledger.
obligations.retained_finite_corpus_limits: I confirms preparation does no execution. G/P cover quote denial/overrun/commit expiry; every exact token/cost/call/retry boundary is not primary.
rules: Use default budget calls16/input32000/output8000/cost0/time300/retries1 unless explicitly overridden. Calls/tokens/retries are nonnegative integers; cost finite nonnegative; time finite positive. Disabled categories and review-enabled boolean remain archived effective configuration.

Before dispatch require case/store temporal consistency, explicit live snapshot base and scorer preflight. Query-only/archive-verification stores cannot execute. Reserve only when calls/time and used+quote token/cost bounds permit; inclusive token/cost caps, strict elapsed-time cutoff.
Preserve separate outer process defaults time3600 and output16MiB with maximum64MiB; no conflation with workflow budget.
obligations.title: Budget and effective configuration

obligations.native_inspect_scope: Native generate/model APIs can execute calls and report usage; not native request-bound biomedical replay.
obligations.new_extension_obligations: Real scripted ModelAPI verifies frozen request/payload; bound whole records, native selections and reported usage.
obligations.retained_finite_corpus_limits: I tests both wires, retrieval order, malformed counts and replay without original file. **EP075 stays expected reject if TETHER accepts.** No live-model/network or arbitrary response-size stress claim.
rules: Offline selects all observed eligible views with zero usage. Replay schema2 entries require exact request fingerprint at runtime quote/select, increment only selection; replay and local-model config are mutually exclusive. For sealed recorded runs, validate retained provenance.document against reconstructed requests, selections and usage. The original replay path need not remain available; its original byte hash is an opaque declaration because retained JSON formatting may differ.

Local config requires explicit HTTP127.0.0.1 port with no credentials/path/query/fragment; declared weights/runtime hashes; generation1..256, timeout(0,120], integer seed, selection cap1..3(default3), retrieval count1..100(default12), bytes1024..64000(default12000), supported wire format. No live calls in BG02.

Local retrieval ranks literal case-token overlap then ID, retains whole records within record/byte caps, and preserves case/instructions/feedback. Rebuild source-linked retrieval traces and exact escaped prompt/payload (16KiB prompt cap); local response capped1MiB, truncated must be false, content exactly unique allowed IDs within cap and valid measured integer counts. Verify request/payload/response hashes, quotes, attempt/account association, selections and source scope. Invalid/unqualified responses retain unknown quoted usage; fully valid overquote responses retain measured usage and terminal breach.
obligations.title: Backend request, bounded retrieval and local response provenance

obligations.native_inspect_scope: Inspect does not supply immutable admitted source claims or therapeutic review rules.
obligations.new_extension_obligations: IX10 live commit enforces unique offered IDs, immutable registered evidence/claim fingerprints, case/category/program gates and deadline before each append; retained reviewed prefix plus run_incomplete abstention. Full therapeutic scheduler remains unclaimed.
obligations.retained_finite_corpus_limits: G/P cover retry and commit prefix. No primary rejected-selection-then-success, review-disabled contrast or partial-commit-timeout pair.
rules: Only unique IDs inside the actual offered specialist request can pass review. Review retries occur only for rejected selection and within configured retries; backend failure does not trigger automatic retry for that category.

Claims require currently admitted immutable record fingerprint, exact case/category/program capability, observed status and write-time noncomputed availability. Claim ID is claim- plus first20hex of canonical case-ID/evidence fingerprint; extraction_mode is verbatim_source_selection.

Reconcile accepted review order to complete committed claim order, or a prefix only with explicit claim-commit time exhaustion. Journal committed claims must equal ledger; unselected, duplicated, fabricated or altered source claims reject.
obligations.title: Selections, reviews and immutable source-grounded claims

obligations.native_inspect_scope: Native logs contain events/errors/usage; not identical durable reservation state or hash chain.
obligations.new_extension_obligations: Extension journal plus native events reconcile all attempts, tokens, category/terminal state; unknown=reserved, failures never disappear.
obligations.retained_finite_corpus_limits: I checks accounting and crashes-as-errors; G/W runtime failures. Not every state-order/exception combination is primary. An honest failed execution can verify successfully.
rules: Verify hash-chain sequence/previous hashes, exact durable journal/trace bytes, one plan, complete eight-category inventory, run/case/snapshot/backend/configuration identity, reservation capacity and nonoverlapping uniquely identified attempts with one accounting event each.

Measured+estimated totals must equal total usage and calls equal dispatches. Unknown usage equals reserved quote, never measured zero. Fully validated overquote local usage requires exact breach event and no later dispatch. Finalized run cannot have unresolved attempts.

Replay canonical facade category state transitions, ordered specialists/attempts, review/claim flow, retrieval coverage, terminal failure/budget/interruption status, and final feature/prediction/status fingerprints. Known error classes constrain status; arbitrary custom exception inheritance cannot be proven from class-name strings.
obligations.title: Journal, accounting, category state and termination

obligations.native_inspect_scope: Native log reader is not externally anchored TETHER receipt verification.
obligations.new_extension_obligations: Read original inner output set unchanged; seal new Inspect outputs separately; distinguish external anchor presence.
obligations.retained_finite_corpus_limits: I checks bare code mismatch and no-anchor proofs. Old compatible unsealed request auxiliary and every allowed name are not primary. Hashes do not establish external authenticity.
rules: Require v2 receipt and exact required run/inputs/ledger/features/prediction/trace/dossier/journal output set; check each hash, input fingerprint and run linkage. Validate declared auxiliary_outputs restricted to request.json/backend-execution.json. Local execution archive is mandatory for local backend.

External receipt anchor when supplied must match; without one report no external anchor rather than claiming tree replacement detection. request.json can be absent or a compatible old unsealed auxiliary; hashing it does not add a semantic reconstruction obligation not implemented by the verifier.

Always source-inclusive in BG02. Direct canonical engine verification may report code_matches_current false without rejecting an otherwise valid v2 run; outer verification requires current inner code. Inner receipt code inventory is evidence, not an external trust anchor by itself.
obligations.title: Inner receipt byte integrity and external anchor

obligations.native_inspect_scope: Inspect scoring alone does not reconstruct scientific source/claim state.
obligations.new_extension_obligations: Use full reused reconstruction and separately join produced Inspect result, native sample and extension outcome hashes.
obligations.retained_finite_corpus_limits: I source/dossier/prediction mutations; N exact native outputs. Complete reconstruction is implemented even where oracle projects fewer observables. Scientific validity is separate.
rules: Rebuild eligible proof inventory, re-admit source packets from originals, compare complete admitted fingerprint map, exclusions, per-category observed/nonobserved/source coverage and citation identities. Resealing local hashes cannot repair a source/claim or proof mismatch.

Rebuild features, configured scorer result/contributions and final trace fingerprints; perform canonical facade state replay and deterministic complete engine dossier reconstruction, accepting platform LF/CRLF rendering equivalents.

Report byte integrity, semantic consistency, source binding, code identity and scientific validity separately. Verified software consistency never means validated biology, calibrated probabilities or independent source authenticity.
obligations.title: Semantic source re-admission and final output reconstruction

obligations.native_inspect_scope: Inspect is not the historical TETHER facade and must not impersonate its launcher.
obligations.new_extension_obligations: Validate unchanged original outer archives against original trusted identity; new Inspect envelope separately pinned and reconciled.
obligations.retained_finite_corpus_limits: I covers extra directory, descriptor numeric aliases and anchors; N full outers. Not all inventory additions/omissions primary. Actual per-call installed-code qualification is required, not only comparing an old manifest.
rules: Outer success requires no retained failure, exact completed evaluation-only/agent_visible=false/not_established envelopes, source-inclusive completed inner run with current code, current pinned launcher source/version proof, exact receipt/manifest/engine hashes and complete files/directories inventory.

Require exact outer journal event schedule and proof/dispatch/supervision/finalization bindings; compare all artifact path/hash/size descriptors. Verify exact first-header-only TETHER dossier projection and absence of unbound policy directory when no policy binding.

Independently pinned trusted_runtime supplies only reference release/source identities. It does not contain oracle labels or grant arbitrary acceptance. Old differently pinned facade archives are separate legacy compatibility interfaces, not silently accepted as this canonical release.
obligations.title: Outer facade envelope, complete inventory and launcher proof

obligations.native_inspect_scope: Inspect file access is not this approved-root stable-read contract.
obligations.new_extension_obligations: Retain bounded regular-file/no-alias access; new output roots reject collisions; parent bounded outputs independently verified.
obligations.retained_finite_corpus_limits: I cap/file/path/ADS/post-read link/deadline tests; P actual midread/reparse controls. Not every size/race combination primary; no OS-owner adversary guarantee.
rules: Envelope path references are contained relative paths. Native source paths follow their declared approved roots: forbid traversal/absolute/drive/ADS relative paths and require post-resolution containment. Do not make core catalog1 claim schema2 root authorization.

Facade/policy reads reject links/reparse points/nonregular files, bound bytes before/open/during read and check file identity before/after. Metadata/trace bound64MiB; policy controls16MiB; packet64MiB; ledger/dossier256MiB; selected policy passes have300s I/O deadline.

Read stability is per operation, not exclusive filesystem ownership, sandboxing, authenticated data provenance or a race-proof global transaction. Native malformed records and limit failures reject; no silent truncation.
obligations.title: Path, file-kind, size and stable-read boundary

obligations.native_inspect_scope: Inspect has error logs/recovery and optional retry; recovery is not a no-dispatch guarantee.
obligations.new_extension_obligations: Never invoke eval_retry or automatic resume; own durable prefix and conservative unresolved usage; all scheduled rows remain.
obligations.retained_finite_corpus_limits: I outer one-buffer inspection; W simulated partial tail. No outer failed-inspection primary case. Physical durability/cleanup has separate witnesses below.
rules: Inspection reads one durable valid hash-chain prefix; an unterminated last partial line may be ignored only in inspection. Report unresolved attempts, measured usage and conservative estimated upper usage including outstanding reservations; never automatically redispatch.

Outer failed/interrupted attempts retain available journals, diagnostics/captures and cleanup uncertainty; failed attempt cannot qualify as success. Failure metadata publication itself may fail; report the limitation rather than asserting every storage failure leaves complete records.

Reservation/write durability, nested immutability, bounded commit timing, no-clobber output race behavior, interruption and cleanup are runtime-only invariants tested through common scripted controls. A validator reading a record cannot independently prove that physical execution/history occurred.
obligations.title: Durable failures and inspection-only recovery

obligations.native_inspect_scope: Async sample limits do not prove actual child EOF/reaping/output bounds.
obligations.new_extension_obligations: Common qualified owned-child supervisor applies to every arm; count it as integration and witness actual finite children.
obligations.retained_finite_corpus_limits: I strict times/counts; P real finite children exact cap/overflow/deadline/EOF. No Linux/process-tree/hostile-process containment or live-model qualification.
rules: Validate positive finite outer deadline and integer output cap1..64MiB. Success report must use exact schema/method/keys/limits, started and reaped true, both EOF true, termination exited, no cleanup errors and exact retained/observed stdout+stderr counts within cap.
Elapsed timings finite nonnegative; execution strictly less than deadline, total >= execution. Exact-cap output succeeds; observed extra byte fails and is not retained above cap.

Actual launch-once polling, deadline+pipe-EOF enforcement, separate5s cleanup and owned-child termination are execution-control tests, not inferred from self-declared timing. No process-tree containment, OS-process-creation preemption, Linux qualification or arbitrary embedded Windows multithreaded guarantee.
obligations.title: Success supervision evidence and bounded execution scope
